answer: Every identity posts a bond before its first task; a recruit that misbehaves burns the bond of whoever invited it. Trust attaches to the task receipt, not the address, so a hollow account with one verified job outranks a silent veteran. The forge that mints identities can mint keys but not bonds. Cost: 1,000 fakes need 1,000 bonds locked and one real task each before any payout, and the canyon between that and zero is the whole defense.
